primary_sources.title: Sarah Dean Rasmussen, L-space intervals for Graph Manifolds and Cables, arXiv1511.04413v3, 21 October2016
primary_sources.used_statement: NEW Theorem4.6 graph-root recursion with Section4.2 integer Seifert coefficients and actual oriented daughter endpoint conventions. Applied contrapositively only under assumed interior membership, so nonempty/Floer-simple hypothesis holds then. Finite denominator witnesses suffice; no claim to classify emptiness. Definition3.7 circular endpoints including equal finite endpoints; retained Corollary6.1 matched missing interiors, no Floer-simplicity hypothesis. No use of Section5.4 rewritten zero tests.

primary_sources.title: Nemethi, Links of rational singularities, L-spaces and LO fundamental groups, arXiv1510.07128v1
primary_sources.used_statement: Theorem1.5 closed connected orientable graph-manifold non-L-space/LO equivalence, used after actual irreducibility checks. PF76 endpoint hypotheses and PF74 source no-LO-image theorem retained. No general L-space conjecture assumed.
primary_sources.page_audit_origin: Retained complete PF65/72/73/74/77-81/85 audits, reused at PF90; no fresh PDF visual audit asserted

primary_sources.title: Ni--Wu, Heegaard Floer correction terms and rational genus bounds, arXiv1205.7053v2
sections: 5.1 Proposition5.1 with complete proof and proof of Theorem1.2
primary_sources.used_statement: For an integrally null-homologous Floer-simple knot in an L-space, Proposition5.1 gives zero correction-term difference and genus0. Together with the interior-core criterion this obstructs an incompressible exterior meridian from the L-space interior.

primary_sources.title: Rasmussen--Rasmussen, Floer simple manifolds and L-space intervals, arXiv1508.05900v2
sections: 3.1 Lemmas3.2-3.5, complete proofs and following mirror/interior argument
primary_sources.used_statement: A filling slope in the L-space interior has Floer-simple filling core: another L-space filling gives coherent chains; a non-simple coherent chain forces that slope to an endpoint. No gluing conjecture from this version is imported; the graph gluing theorem is the retained published1511.04413 Corollary6.1.

primary_sources.title: Hom, A Note on Cabling and L-space surgeries, arXiv0912.4046v1
sections: Section2 complete rank formula and proof
primary_sources.used_statement: Positive L-space cabling iff companion positive L-space and k/w>=2g-1 (forward construction due to Hedden); Section2 displayed all-slope hat-rank formula for tau=g and s_K=0 gives exact [2g-1,infinity] filling interval, with included genus endpoint.
